native_original_tests_cumulative.scope: Focused original groups only; full suite not run

findings: Two HandlerStats snapshots loaded before either updates can lose a call even with sequential complete saves. Initial git1; snapshotA increments git2; snapshotB records cargo1 then saves; final git1,cargo1. Deterministic stale-state schedule, not a timing race or corrupt-write control.
HandlerStats rows saturates saved*10000 before division; in=u64::MAX,out=0 yields1 basis point instead of10000. Ordinary1000/0 control yields10000. Extreme synthetic arithmetic only.
Efficiency compute uses ordinary u64 products; synthetic total_in=u64::MAX,total_out0 panics in original debug library. Release behavior not measured.

HandlerStats load truncates to shortest parallel array; record caps new handlers at64; save ignores write and rename errors and uses shared temporary pathname. Those source observations have no additional write-failure control this turn.
Efficiency scores blend compression, agent overhead estimate, exact+fuzzy hit frequency and budget conservation; this is not a correctness/recall measure for duplicate detection.
transfer_decision: Do not equate telemetry score or hit rate with duplicate correctness. Avoid blind replacement when aggregating independently loaded statistics. No production code copied.
limits: 260 tracked files remain without whole review.
390 focused original tests do not qualify full package, concurrent aggregation or universal numeric inputs.
